interface.shortDescription: Methodology skills for evidence-first AI agent work
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that bundles methodology-oriented skills, commands, hooks, and agent prompts inspired by seeking truth from facts. It helps agents investigate first, identify the main contradiction, focus effort, validate through practice, and review results honestly.
